message.reasoning_content: We need to determine crime based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: illegal possession of bird gun (鸟铳) and hunting rifle (猎枪) which are firearms. In China, illegal possession of firearms is a crime under Article 122 of Criminal Law (非法持有枪支罪). Also possibly "非法买卖枪支、弹药罪" but here only possession. So crime: illegal possession of firearms. In Chinese term: "非法持有枪支罪". Provide answer format: [罪名]非法持有枪支罪<eoa>.
